versions.content: When receiving an N-PDU containing a TP.CM_BAM or a TP.CM_RTS the J1939Tp module shall first notify the upper layer (PDU Router) before processing the frame reassembly. It uses the PduR_J1939TpStartOfReception function with the following parameters: - the Identifier of the corresponding N-SDU, - depending on the configured meta data items: the SA, DA and Priority, - the total Data Length (after reassembly) and - a pointer to a location where the upper layer stores its currently available buffer size.
